rationale: John brings deep expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and agentic AI—areas where startups often need technical guidance—while Lisa is building something at Redbey Lakes LLC that could benefit from that infrastructure and AI perspective. As a community leader and engineering manager who mentors on cloud and ML, John is well-positioned to offer practical insights, though Lisa's work remains limited in public data.
intro_message: John Komarnicki, meet Lisa Wang — John's background in cloud infrastructure and agentic AI could be valuable context as you build out Redbey Lakes, and he's actively mentoring founders on modern deployment and AI practices.
